correctness.rationale: The source's PMF telescopes exactly: with \(p_w=S_c(w)-S_c(w+1)\), inclusive survival is \(S_c(w)\) and strict survival is \(S_c(w+1)\). Therefore the paper's Eq. (4) denominator is one lattice step too far. Algebra gives the exact relation \(\psi_{\rm pub}=h/(1-h)\), and the source quantity exceeds one at \(w=0,\kappa=3\). The standard PGF tail-sum identity uses inclusive survival, so substituting the shifted sequence changes the PGF and lowers every finite source mean by \(S_c(1)\). The packaged checker independently reproduces the PMF, PGF, hazard, and mean comparisons.

value.rationale: Hazard shape, PGF, moments, and moment-based inference are presented as core mathematical and reliability properties of the new count model. The indexing error changes a purported conditional probability into odds, allowing values above one, and shifts the printed mean by a fixed parameter-dependent amount. This is a structural correction that affects the interpretation of the hazard plots and any use of the displayed PGF-derived moment formulas.
